content.description: Hand pouring ATF fluid into torque converter

content.text: If the torque converter has been drained and washed, refill with fresh ATF.

items: ATF capacity: 2.0 liters (2.1 US qts, 1.8 Imp. qts)

content.description: Measuring torque converter installation depth with calipers and straight edge from installed surface to front surface of transmission housing

content.text: Using calipers and a straight edge, measure from the installed surface to the front surface of the transmission housing.

content.description: Installing guide pin in torque converter with alignment diagram showing guide pin, drive plate holes, and converter housing

content.text: 8. INSTALL GUIDE PIN IN TORQUE CONVERTER
Be careful not to tilt the transmission forward because the torque converter could slide out.

items: (a) Align the guide pin with one of the drive plate holes.
(b) Align two sleeves on the block with the converter housing.

content.description: Bottom view of engine showing locations of four transmission housing mounting bolts and starter installation position

items: (b) Install the four transmission housing mounting bolts.

content.description: Tightening torque converter bolts with socket wrench, showing access through crankshaft rotation

items: (b) Install the six bolts finger tight. Turn the crankshaft to gain access.
